description: Retrieve a single file-based identity resolution job by its match_id (= segment_id). Returns full details including matching_status, file_format, compression, field_counts, source_job_id, audience_id, audience_status, and error_message if failed. Matching capacity consumption is reported after the first successful delivery. Its monetary estimate is denominated in USD and covers the matching component separately from delivery. audience_status (active/archived/null) reports whether the linked audience is still open-able in Library. mapping_warnings lists problems with how the file's columns were used (code nested_addresses means the addresses column was ignored in whole or part) — tell the user about any entries. Use to check job progress after create_segment(subtype=matched), or to retrieve the audience_id for delivery. Requires 'discovery' scope.
